content: auto-maple (tanjeffreyz) records minimap player positions into a quadtree Layout pickled per routine, runs an A*-style shortest_path with horizontal/vertical 'teleport' neighbors within move_tolerance, and Move executes blocking per-waypoint loops with sleeps and a shared max_steps=15 budget that returns silently on exhaustion. No explicit platform/rope graph; class-specific step() supplied by command books.
